groups.name: Session Manager
groups.mechanics: A watchdog wakes the scheduler, which picks queued PRDs, runs each as a headless Claude executor in its own git worktree, then gates, validates, and lands the result. Most of this site was built that way.

jobs.name: Scheduler watchdog
jobs.desc: Keeps the PRD scheduler running: picks up queued work and launches headless executors.

groups.name: Social Signals Trader
groups.mechanics: On market days a tick wakes every 15 minutes, reads the signals Burrow gathered overnight, and manages the Alpaca account. Snapshots and audits publish the results to the public dashboard.

jobs.name: Trader tick
jobs.desc: Reads fresh signals, sizes positions, and places or manages orders. The first and last ticks of the day only manage open positions.

jobs.name: Snapshot
jobs.desc: Captures account value vs SPY, positions, and the trade log for the public dashboard.

jobs.name: Execution audit
jobs.desc: Checks that every intended trade actually filled the way the strategy said it should.

jobs.name: Options status
jobs.desc: Refreshes the summary of open options positions.

jobs.name: Log rotation
jobs.desc: Rolls over the day’s data logs after the close.

jobs.name: Boot catch-up
jobs.desc: If the machine restarts mid-session, runs any tick it missed.

groups.name: Git Viewer
groups.mechanics: A scheduled GitHub Actions run pulls every repo through the GitHub API, bakes the result into one data file, and redeploys the dashboard.

jobs.name: Data sync + deploy
jobs.desc: Fetches repo stats through the GitHub API, bakes them into the dashboard, and redeploys it.

groups.name: Blog
groups.mechanics: A cadence watchdog checks how long it has been since the last post and drafts a catch-up when the gap gets too long. A second timer checks that the watchdog itself is still alive.

jobs.name: Watchdog heartbeat
jobs.desc: A dead-man’s switch: confirms the cadence watchdog has run recently.

jobs.name: Cadence watchdog
jobs.desc: Measures the gap since the last live post and drafts a catch-up post when it is too long.

groups.name: Burrow — the agency engine
groups.mechanics: Burrow is the local agent under everything else. It drives a real browser through Reddit, X, LinkedIn, Discord, and Facebook at human speed, indexes what it reads into a searchable knowledge base, and gathers the ticker data that feeds Social Signals Trader. Each pipeline has its own cron line.

jobs.name: Knowledge server keepalive
jobs.desc: Restarts the knowledge-base server if it stops answering.

jobs.name: Research worker
jobs.desc: Works through queued research questions against the knowledge base.

jobs.name: Targeted ticker gather
jobs.desc: Pulls fresh discussion for the tickers the trader is watching right now.

jobs.name: Health snapshot
jobs.desc: Records whether every pipeline is running on time.

jobs.name: Web opinion search
jobs.desc: Searches the open web for opinions on watched tickers.

jobs.name: Ticker data state
jobs.desc: Tracks how fresh the data is for each watched ticker, so gathers go where they are needed.

jobs.name: bilko.run ping
jobs.desc: Checks that this site is up.

jobs.name: Ticker search gather
jobs.desc: Broad search for ticker mentions across sources.

jobs.name: Discord session
jobs.desc: Reads trading Discord channels and captures ticker discussion.

jobs.name: Distill
jobs.desc: Condenses new captures into short insights with Claude.

jobs.name: Knowledge indexer
jobs.desc: Chunks and embeds new captures into the knowledge base.

jobs.name: Ticker tagging
jobs.desc: Tags indexed posts with the tickers they mention, for the trader’s signal scoring.

jobs.name: Stats snapshot
jobs.desc: Rolls up posts, replies, captures, and knowledge-base growth.

jobs.name: FB Football news
jobs.desc: Posts as European Football Daily: web-sourced news plus a generated image.

jobs.name: FB Bilko post
jobs.desc: Posts short AI-education essays with generated images as Bilko Bibitkov.

jobs.name: Short interest
jobs.desc: Collects short-interest data for watched tickers.

jobs.name: Capture retention
jobs.desc: Clears out old raw captures once they are indexed.

jobs.name: Catalyst calendar
jobs.desc: Collects upcoming earnings and other catalyst dates.

jobs.name: Google Trends
jobs.desc: Collects search-interest trends for watched tickers.

jobs.name: LinkedIn session
jobs.desc: Reads the LinkedIn feed and captures posts into the knowledge base.

jobs.name: Reddit session
jobs.desc: Human-paced scroll through followed subreddits; captures posts for the knowledge base and the trader.

jobs.name: X session
jobs.desc: Scrolls X, captures posts, and drafts the day’s post and replies.
